text_block_list.text: Sigh... I couldn't take center stage today.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: It was still a great concert.

text_block_list.text:
Winning concerts really are amazing,
though. I
was so excited.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Just being able to sing and dance in
front of
everyone is super fun!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: I bet center stage will be even more fun.

text_block_list.text:
All right! Next time, I'll make sure I'm in
the
center!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm aiming to be a top
Umadol! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Her determination renewed, Smart
Falcon seems
full of enthusiasm as we
discuss our path moving
forward.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I've got a question for you! What's the
first thing
a freshly-debuted Umadol has
to do?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Nope! Well, actually, you're not entirely
wrong!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But Umadols are all about practical
experience!
I've gotta get more fans by
putting on real
concerts! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I wanna run tons of races, and this time,
I'll take
center stage!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Then first, we'll have to win a maiden race.

text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I'm still limited in the races I
can
compete in.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Runners who don't win their debut can
only
compete in maiden races. Once
we're over that
hurdle, we can move on
to more ambitious
goals...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Let's aim for first in the higher-level races!

text_block_list.text:
If she places first in those races, she'll
naturally
attract more attention.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
If we can win at least two races, I think people
will really start noticing you!

text_block_list.text: Okay! ☆ I just gotta win, then!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Let's make everybody remember the

up-and-coming Umadol, Falco! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We set our sights on winning at least two
races at
the Pre-Open level или выше
during junior year to
jump-start Smart
Falcon's fame.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
